text:
maria_peopleops: Quick check-in before I publish the Q2 review timeline. Two items: confirm the 48h grace policy for self-assessments and async calibration process for OOO managers. Reply with a one-liner. :wave:

linda_hr: We keep a 48-hour grace for documented launch conflicts. After that, late uploads need manager sign-off and are flagged in the audit log.

eng-manager-lee: For async calibration can we do "vote + short justification" on the sheet? That's easiest for sched conflicts.

calib-lead-priya: Yes — please use the Calibration sheet: add your vote in the "Vote" column and a 1-2 line rationale in the "Notes" column. Leads will log any offline votes in the meeting minutes.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Manager draft comments due in 72 hours for managers on the early-review list. Check your calendar.

maria_peopleops: Upload/checklist I'll publish tonight:
- IC self-assessments due: 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT (48h grace until 2026-04-12 23:59)
- Manager comments due: 2026-04-12 17:00 PDT
- Final uploads to /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q2 by 2026-04-13 12:00 PDT
- Calibration voting closes: 2026-04-14 10:00 PDT

linda_hr: Short blurb managers can forward to teams: "Include top 3 outcomes with metrics, 1-2 examples of collaboration, and one growth goal. Attach 1-2 artifacts (PRs/dashboards). ~200-300 words."

eng-manager-lee: Forwarding now. Also I'll escalate any extension requests beyond the 48h grace to HR.

maria_peopleops: Thanks all. Calibration leads please confirm slots by EOD or I'll auto-assign. Posting final timeline in #announcements tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
